name: Directional Boundary Re-Anchoring prospective replication

controls.down: BTC down AND long stop boundary anchored
controls.up: BTC up AND short stop boundary anchored

primary_metric: event minus anchored-control mean counter-directional position reallocation
rules: Only timestamps strictly after discovery_cutoff_utc are prospective.
Do not recalculate the discovery cutoff.
Do not optimize a BTC-return threshold.
Do not change the stop-migration definition.
Do not change the primary 20-minute horizon.
Do not discard unfavorable prospective events.
Do not modify the rule after seeing prospective outcomes.
40-minute and 60-minute horizons are secondary diagnostics only.
No trading or profitability conclusion is implied.
